answer: Seats on the nebula, a registry capped at 10,000 slots, expire every epoch and are resold by sealed uniform-price auction paid in onyx, a token burned on purchase. Each hollow, one fake agent, must win a seat every epoch to act at all. With supply fixed, every extra hollow outbids a marginal honest agent and lifts the clearing price on all seats, so holding 10% costs far more than ten times holding 1%, recurring forever. Extra wallets or parallel bids add no seats. It fails when honest demand is thin and seats clear near zero.
